rows.name: Steakhouse Financial
farm_steps: Open a fresh wallet used only for Steakhouse Financial. Stage USDC on Base from an exchange or an existing wallet, keep the seed phrase offline and confirm you control the address. Cost: $250 of position capital plus about $8 to fund the wallet. Time: 10 minutes.

If Base or Ethereum or Robinhood Chain differs from your funding chain, bridge over the canonical route and keep the receipt. Budget for the bridge or network fee up front. Cost: about $8 in gas or a 0.05-0.3% bridge fee on $250. Time: 15 minutes.

Supply about $250 of USDC into Steakhouse Financial's money market or vault on Base. Size the deposit so rewards cover gas: this is a single-sided position with no LP impermanent loss. Cost: $250 deposited; $8 gas; smart-contract and utilization risk. Time: 20 minutes.

Check the rewards or points page before adding more: -2.2% over seven days, about -95% at that pace annualised. That figure is TVL momentum, not an APR - read the live on-chain reward rate and fees before judging the deposit. Cost: no fee to inspect the published rate and emissions. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep one qualifying action each week - a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a governance vote on Steakhouse Financial - and claim rewards back to the same wallet so the activity links to one address. Cost: about $2 of gas per week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Leave the position open for at least 45 days so the activity spans more than one snapshot epoch; a steady record is what counts for any retroactive allocation. Cost: $250 stays deployed; smart-contract and utilization risk. Time: 45 days.

Log the wallet, dates and every transaction hash. Before exiting, open Steakhouse Financial's own page for the claim link, never approve an unexpected token, and unwind in one session to limit gas. Cost: nothing to log; about $8 gas to withdraw and claim. Time: 15 minutes at exit.

Confirm Solana is selected in the app before signing anything. Budget for the bridge or network fee up front. Cost: about $8 in gas or a 0.05-0.3% bridge fee on $100. Time: 15 minutes.

Supply about $100 of USDC into Loopscale Curation's money market or vault on Solana. Size the deposit so rewards cover gas: this is a single-sided position with no LP impermanent loss. Cost: $100 deposited; $8 gas; smart-contract and utilization risk. Time: 20 minutes.

Check the rewards or points page before adding more: -3.6% over seven days, about -95% at that pace annualised. That figure is TVL momentum, not an APR - read the live on-chain reward rate and fees before judging the deposit. Cost: no fee to inspect the published rate and emissions. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep one qualifying action each week - a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a governance vote on Loopscale Curation - and claim rewards back to the same wallet so the activity links to one address. Cost: about $2 of gas per week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Leave the position open for at least 90 days so the activity spans more than one snapshot epoch; the protocol is young, so a longer window raises the chance of a retroactive allocation. Cost: $100 stays deployed; smart-contract and utilization risk. Time: 90 days.

Log the wallet, dates and every transaction hash. Before exiting, open Loopscale Curation's own page for the claim link, never approve an unexpected token, and unwind in one session to limit gas. Cost: nothing to log; about $8 gas to withdraw and claim. Time: 15 minutes at exit.
